artifact.answer: The API returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while enabling credentials. Credentialed browser requests require an explicit allowed origin, such as https://app.domain.com, not a wildcard. Configure CORS with that exact origin and keep allow_credentials=True; SameSite=Lax cookies should be sent for a same-site cross-origin request.
